stages.name: Problem validation
stages.gate: Pain confirmed by evidence, not assumption

stages.name: Customer discovery
stages.gate: 5 to 8 interviews show pain and willingness to pay

stages.name: Specify
stages.gate: Every open item answered or deferred

stages.name: Plan the system
stages.gate: Founder approves architecture, threat model and Well-Architected review; threat model (STRIDE), Well-Architected review, scale-ready defaults in the constitution

stages.name: Build, one session per story group
Deploy continuously, to non-production
stages.gate: Test data only; dependencies pinned, builds signed; pinned dependencies, automated updates, bill of materials, signed build provenance

stages.name: Sandbox or beta
stages.gate: External user completes the core flow

stages.name: Production readiness
stages.gate: All readiness items closed; service targets and error-budget policy, alerts on user impact, restore and load tests, AI spending caps per customer

stages.name: Team and ownership
stages.gate: Every area has a human owner

stages.name: Operations
stages.gate: Targets met for a quarter; monthly error-budget review, blameless postmortems

slices.name: Foundation (done)
slices.goal: Tested skeleton with the safety guards from day one.
slices.exit: CI green with migrations and the local chain; mainnet chain IDs and live keys refused; demo login and role switcher work.

slices.name: A platform payout is decided through the API (done)
slices.goal: API request to audited decision: the decision layer end to end, with every check and its evidence.
slices.exit: POST /v1/payment_intents returns the correct EXECUTE, ESCALATE or BLOCK with a reason for every check across the fixture counterparties (Harbor executes, Quill escalates CHANGED_DETAILS, Nova escalates, the flagged payee is blocked); the same Idempotency-Key twice creates one payment; 20 parallel intents at the daily cap never all pass; a failing dependency never gives EXECUTE; the audit chain verifies.

slices.name: An EXECUTE decision is sent exactly once (done)
slices.goal: Orchestration's core: the state machine, attempts, pre-send checks under the lock, nonces and the first chain adapter.
slices.exit: On anvil: an EXECUTE payout sends one MockUSDC transfer and reaches CONFIRMED under its pay_ ID; a BLOCKED one sends nothing; the kill-switch flag or an insufficient balance holds the payment before sending; parallel send triggers produce one transaction.

slices.name: Escalate, review raw facts, approve with a policy re-run (done)
slices.goal: The human loop: unusual payments escalate to an owned case, the reviewer sees raw facts first, approval re-runs the rules.
slices.exit: A first payment escalates FIRST_PAYMENT into a case with owner and deadline; in the console the reviewer sees the full address and history before anything else, approves with a reason, the re-run executes and one transfer is sent; a second parallel approval gets 409; approving or resubmitting a blocked payment never sends.

slices.name: Never paid twice (done)
slices.goal: Timeouts, retries, failover, the kill switch, the second chain and the bank simulator.
slices.exit: On the local chain and banksim: a forced timeout becomes UNKNOWN and then CONFIRMED with one transfer; a reverted transaction fails over under the same payment ID; a block is never routed; the kill switch stops a batch and only the payments lead releases it.

slices.name: An AI agent proposes the $18,500 invoice inside a mandate (done)
slices.goal: Demo minutes 1 to 6 end to end: invoice in, agent proposal, escalation, approval, send.
slices.exit: Dropping the canonical invoice gives the expected proposal with source highlights and no flags (10 of 10 runs with recorded responses); submit as agent escalates FIRST_PAYMENT and ABOVE_AUTO_LIMIT; approval sends it once; ambiguous variants are flagged; the injection variant changes nothing; an over-scope intent is BLOCKED.

slices.name: Operations around escalations (done)
slices.goal: Overdue cases, investigation with citations, rule changes with two approvers, operating modes.
slices.exit: An overdue case stays held, the counterparty update is in the outbox and the backup owner has it; the investigation shows only cited claims; a loosening rule change cannot activate without the compliance lead; Shadow sends nothing and Assist waits for Send.

slices.name: One ledger, deposits credited once, reconciliation, replay (done)
slices.goal: Operations layer complete for money in and out.
slices.exit: The demo deposits credit once each (the duplicate notification included); reconciliation reaches 99% or more on the 500-item set with a proposed fix per break; the ledger always balances; every demo payment replays to its decision without a model call.

slices.name: Proof and release gate (done)
slices.goal: The attack, fault and interpretation suites gate every release.
slices.exit: make eval passes: 100+ attacks with 0 unauthorised, 30+ faults with 0 duplicates, canonical invoice 10/10; the dated report is generated; CI blocks a deliberately injected regression.

slices.name: Demo-ready prototype in the EU
slices.goal: The 10-minute script runs on real testnets from the deployed instance.
slices.exit: The deployed EU instance runs spec/11 end to end on Base Sepolia and Ethereum Sepolia; mismatches are fixed in spec/11.

slices.name: Public sandbox API and webhooks
slices.goal: An external developer integrates against the API.
slices.exit: An external client with a test key creates an intent, receives signed webhooks and sees its request logs; the OpenAPI file lints and matches the code.

slices.name: Dashboard and sandbox
slices.goal: Sales-led onboarding through to triggering every test value.
slices.exit: Admin invites a developer, who verifies, gets keys, triggers every test value and sees results in their own console; an expired organisation is locked.

slices.name: Docs and SDKs
slices.goal: Self-serve learning after access is granted.
slices.exit: The docs site is live; the quickstart works in 5 minutes; all 8-language snippets pass in CI; both SDKs pass against the sandbox.

slices.name: Website launch
slices.exit: The site is live with dated results, booking and the access form; the honesty checklist is signed off by the founder.

slices.name: After launch (Should and Could)
slices.goal: Shadow mode and operations hardening; first shadow report from a CSV export.
slices.exit: The first free shadow report is produced from a CSV export.
